correctness.rationale: Exact orthogonal spectral projectors and their eigenvalues reconstruct every update entry for all part sizes. Degree-two and degree-four scalar positivity and a negative within-part discriminant leave only the cross-part cutoffs. Degree-three strict decrease and exact within-part factor produce precisely the listed finite thresholds. The all-size order comparison, sharp partition extremizers and odd-size inequality are reconstructed algebraically. Standalone rational verifier passed 23,634 independent entry comparisons and 3,582 threshold checks; these finite results supplement rather than prove universal statements.

value.rationale: Gives a complete exact quantitative endpoint-positivity classification for common second-, third- and fourth-order explicit diffusion updates on every finite connected complete multipartite graph, including a surprising third-order versus second-order reversal at five vertices and exact part-profile worst/best-case optimizers. These are motivated graph design and timestep selection facts, not a table of arbitrary numerical cases.
